ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool - NetSupport Execution From Unusual Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of client32.exe (NetSupport RAT) from an unusual location (outside of 'C:\Program Files')

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\client32\\\.exe$") OR process_product = RGX(".*NetSupport\\ Remote\\ Control.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*client32\\\.exe.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=a9d50692e95b79723f3e76fcf70d023e.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\")))
